evidence.role: Enforces the half-open request window and records the request timestamp.
Computes the exclusive request and callback deadlines.
Provides the sole external callback gateway and dispatches to the Raffle handler.
Ignores callbacks at or after the deadline; resolution writes occur only when the strict-before condition holds.

searched.result: Read in full; all 31 dependency hashes returned OK.
25 hits; enforcement resolves to Raffle.sol:L240-L253, L458-L465, L509-L520 and RaffleConstants.sol:L35-L36.
14 hits; one implementation entrypoint, one interface declaration, and no alternate base or wrapper request route.
3 fulfill hits and 1 raw-fulfill hit: one abstract declaration, one gateway dispatch, one Raffle override, and one external gateway.
Only Raffle.sol:L253-L260 writes drawRequestedAt/vrfRequestId/_requestInFlight; only L519-L520 writes winningEntry/resolvedAt.
0 hits; broader timing vocabulary found no alternate callback-acceptance path.

reasoning: The request gate rejects timestamps before sale end and at or after sale end plus two days. Every externally reachable callback passes through the authenticated base gateway and the single Raffle override, whose common guard ignores block.timestamp >= drawRequestedAt + 2 days. Thus equality is excluded and no branch, caller, modifier, clone path, or alternate resolution writer permits late acceptance. The uint64 timestamp cast can only make the extreme-horizon behavior stricter, not create a late-acceptance path under the supplied one-way checkable property.
